description:

For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
2027 Global Procurement Intern Overview:
Envision spending your summer working with energetic colleagues and inspirational leaders, all while gaining world-class experience in one of the most dynamic organizations in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a reality for Global Procurement Interns at AbbVie. As a Global Procurement Intern, you will participate in a paid 11-week summer program working on meaningful assignments that impact our business and patients worldwide.
You will gain exposure to AbbVie’s global Procurement organization and contribute to projects across areas such as strategic sourcing, category and supplier management, analytics, risk, sustainability, and digital innovation. Assignments may vary based on business needs, skills, and interests.
Key responsibilities may include:
Support strategic sourcing, category management, supplier management, and other Procurement initiatives.
Analyze spend, supplier, market, or other business data to identify insights and support decision-making.
Collaborate with Procurement and cross-functional teams on strategic projects and business challenges.
Explore opportunities to improve processes through technology, AI, automation, and analytics.
Build business, financial, project management, and stakeholder relationship skills.
Minimum Qualifications:
Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related field with expected graduation between December 2027 and June 2028.
Must be enrolled in university the semester following the internship.
Demonstrated leadership through academics, extracurricular activities, work experience, or community involvement.
Experience with Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint.
Preferred Qualifications:
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Demonstrated teamwork, initiative, adaptability, and eagerness to learn.
Interest in procurement, supply chain, business strategy, analytics, or supplier management.
Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python, AI, automation, or similar tools is a plus.

title: Account Specialist, Migraine - Cleveland, OH
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Purpose
Describe the primary goals, objectives or functions or outputs of this position.
The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy. Or in Urology, specialists such as urology, urogynecology, obstetrics and gynecology, female pelvic medicine, ambulatory surgical centers, and reconstructive surgery.
Responsibilities
Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
Ability to lift/pull 25–100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. Account management and/or marketing experience in a healthcare or related business

Proven capability in contract negotiation, stakeholder engagement, and driving commercial results.

title: Associate Director, AMI Curricula
description:
About AbbVie
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/ . Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
The Associate Director of AMI Curricula is responsible for the development of curricula across Allergan Medical Institute educational programs, primarily new large group programs in-field and in the Training Centers. Main responsibilities include collaboration with key stakeholders (AMI Programs team, Customer Marketing teams, Training Centers team, Design & Internal review team, etc) to develop content to achieve our educational objectives across the HCP learning journey.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned.):
Lead the development of AMI curricula across all large group programming in the AMI Training Centers and in-field programming
Strategic oversight of AMI content and tactics as it relates to large group programs, including: Net new program creation based on Learning Journey, business needs, market demand
Go to market strategy for new programs through Field and digital channels
Strategy for Faculty speaker training and selection, ongoing Faculty training post-launch
Oversight of development of all training materials, videos, slide decks, etc, aligning to brand strategy, KOL review, and adult learning principles
Curricula Lead for all internal Sales communications, including: Liaison between Curricula and Faculty Development team
Coordination of any new initiatives with Commercial Directors

Independently designs, reviews, and approves study-specific clinical label content and templates for global clinical studies, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant labeling that enables uninterrupted clinical supply. Manage multiple simultaneous studies and competing priorities with independent judgment, accurate status communication, and accountability for on-time, right-first-time delivery.
Collaborate cross-functionally to improve labeling processes, support team goals and operational initiatives, and identify, resolve, or appropriately escalate issues that may affect clinical supply or patient dosing continuity.

Working knowledge of GMP/cGMP and global clinical-labeling requirements, including US, EU, JAPAC, and other country-specific regulations; familiarity with CFR, EU Annex 13, and ICH principles.
Ability to interpret clinical protocols, apply regulatory requirements, produce accurate documentation, and exercise sound independent judgment in review and approval decisions.
Strong quality, analytical, organizational, project-management, communication, and issue-escalation skills; ability to manage simultaneous studies and timeline commitments.
Preferred Qualifications:
3–5+ years of clinical trial design, clinical labeling, packaging, or pharmaceutical manufacturing experience.
Experience with validated label design systems, controlled phrase libraries, booklet labels, vendor proof review, inventory/resupply processes, and change management.
Experience collaborating with Clinical Supply, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, and third-party manufacturing or labeling vendors.

The  Senior Associate, Regulatory Affairs Submission Management , manages medium to high impact, moderately complex submission projects involving multiple cross-functional regulatory submission teams. With input from the submission teams, this individual establishes and maintains submission content planners and associated timelines, facilitates tactical submission team meetings, prepares content planners for publishing, interfaces with publishing vendor, and fulfills Submission Management functions on Project Teams in support of Development, Marketing, and post-marketing regulatory authority applications. This individual is recognized as very knowledgeable in their discipline expert and in regulatory affairs submission management.
Responsibilities:
Manages medium to high impact (with respect to internal visibility, risk, complexity and criticality) submission projects to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality dossiers that meet technical specifications defined by regulatory authorities and can be easily navigated and reviewed by a regulatory agency.

Plans and conducts submission team meetings. Expedites, manages, and coordinates multiple concurrent interrelated activities for submission projects and/or for multiple products in the delivery of moderately complex published submissions within the required timelines. Anticipates obstacles and develop solutions within the team.

Facilitates the creation or procurement of submission content deliverables such as cover letters and forms.

Suggests and contributes to process improvements, including changes to software and business processes. May participate on internal project teams to update business software.
Demonstrates team leadership skills and ability to influence without direct authority. Builds and maintains positive relationships internally and externally.

Trains, and mentors less experienced staff.

The SSP is responsible for adopting relationship management principles and critically thinking to better understand all business dimensions to impact and drive operational efficiencies in the conduct of AbbVie’s pipeline. Provides input and develop the site-specific engagement strategy for assigned sites.
Builds and manages relationships with assigned investigative sites through a white-glove service. approach while meeting with Institution Leadership, Principal Investigator and clinical site staff both on-site and remotely.
Raises the bar to proactively anticipate a site’s needs and drives timely mitigation strategies.
Maintains a solution-oriented mindset to facilitate resolution of complex operational issues.
Remains informed of best practices and innovations that have resulted in efficiencies across the business and/or industry and put actions in place that support the organization in removing identified barriers.
Identifies areas to drive efficiencies and/or accelerate clinical trial execution. Drives consistency across studies and programs.
Oversees overall performance metrics across studies, conducts review of site’s operations for quality. Evaluates and addresses aligned KPIs with site.
Reviews and shares upcoming study forecasts and current clinical study needs regarding the studies in which the site is participating for strategic resource planning with the site.
Reviews interests and study capacity with site and communicates back to internal AbbVie stakeholders.
Identifies and recommends opportunities for internal improvements, implements improvements to maximize process efficiency/accelerate trial delivery at the site.
Reviews cross business portfolio forecasts of studies to provide direction for investigative sites.
Escalates risk to relevant stakeholders, resolves identified operational issues that span across studies/programs.
Seeks to align AbbVie and the site's operations to execute clinical trials efficiently.
Provides operational and holistic focus on site needs to ensure optimal delivery of clinical trials.
Generates, expands and enhances operational effectiveness and consistency within AbbVie and at the investigative sites.
Works closely with internal stakeholders to facilitate, manage and oversee the scientific and operational relationships cross functionally across AbbVie to ensure a productive working environment.
Provides cross-functional partners an open and continuous channel of communication to ensure investigative sites perspectives are heard and well represented internally.
Bachelors or higher degree required, degree in health care or scientific field preferred.
Minimum of 10 years applicable work experience in clinical research demonstrating a high level of core, technical, and leadership competencies through driving strategy. Prior relationship management experience preferred.
Broad understanding of global pharmaceutical and biotech industries with a solid understanding of drug discovery and development processes. Expertise in drug development, operations, strategic and tactical planning,
Strong communication skills with advanced interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate persuasively with clarity, collaboratively, and cross functionally.
Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills; ability to establish good working relationships with external and internal stakeholders as well as management.
Seamless collaborator with demonstrated ability to influence without authority – easily builds relationships across locations and gains cross-functional alignment.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives and drive smart decision making.
Demonstrated leadership, influence skills, creativity, problem solving and ability to manage complexity in addressing issues.
Demonstration of success in a fast‐paced environment managing multiple priorities, comfortable to manage risk and ambiguity, changing course when needed.
Must possess excellent oral and written communication skills.
Ability to travel up approximately 10%-20% of the time for on-site partner engagements.  Additional travel may be required.

title: 2027 MBA Intern - Digital Strategy Associate, Strategic Advisory
description:
The Opportunity
The Digital Strategy Group (DSG) works with C-level leadership at Adobe's top customers to craft strategies for customer-experience transformation and digital innovation. As part of our Strategic Advisory team, you'll partner directly with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build the transformation roadmaps that elevate and transform our customers' digital experience.
What You'll Do
Take part in client-facing strategy engagements for customers. In each engagement, you'll join a dedicated team working to solve our customers' biggest digital transformation challenges. You'll work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product experts, and enterprise architects to deliver value for customers. We seek candidates who can contribute in one or more of the
following areas:
Leverage data, research, and industry insights to help customers understand the current state of their digital experience and how their own customers experience their digital platforms
Partner with customers to define bold digital visions, align executive leadership, and build transformation roadmaps that drive business outcomes
Lead the development of innovation and discovery workshops that bring cross-functional stakeholders together to align on business priorities, surface challenges, and co-create transformation opportunities
Translate customer goals and pain points into prioritized use cases and a sequenced roadmap for Adobe investment
Drive high-value opportunities end-to-end, from account planning and qualification through deal closure
Develop as a business leader! You'll learn about a wide range of Adobe products as you collaborate with people across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Professional Services. The Digital Strategy Group supports clients across the following industries: Retail & Consumer Goods, High Tech & Manufacturing, Financial Services & Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communications, Media & Travel, and Public Sector. You'll complete a survey close to your start date to determine your industry team, where you'll deepen your subject matter expertise as you execute strategy engagements.
What You Need to Succeed
Currently enrolled full time and pursuing an MBA, graduating between December 2027 and June 2028
Ability to participate in a full time internship between May - September 2027
Outstanding record of academic achievement
Interest in business strategy, technology, or experience design through coursework, extracurricular activities or work/internship experience
Proven analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including independently conducting research, analyzing data, developing hypotheses, and synthesizing recommendations
Experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, including executives
Ability to communicate sophisticated ideas and craft strong narratives both verbally and in writing
Ability to project manage multiple moving parts simultaneously, navigate ambiguity, and lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment
Desirable But Not Essential
Experience creating digital/brand/media strategies along with a practical understanding of the technologies and tactics necessary for execution
Experience in one of the following industry groups: Retail, Travel & Hospitality, Media & Entertainment, Financial Services, Healthcare, High Tech, Manufacturing, Auto, Public Sector

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. description:
Overview of Adobe’s Student Athlete Micro-Internship
Adobe's Student-Athlete Micro Internship Program is focused on giving athletes a unique opportunity to gain valuable skills and work on real-world projects. As an Adobe intern, you’ll put your smarts and creativity to work on business-critical projects, you’ll be mentored by the top talents in your field, and you’ll get all the credit when you dream up our next big thing. Our SAMI Internship Program is 8 weeks long (May 24th, 2027 - July 23rd, 2028) and part-time (25 hours per week).
The Opportunity
The Adobe Sales Academy is a multi-phase world-class accelerated sales program built to take top sales talent from a Sales Development Rep (SDR) to an Enterprise Field Account Executive (AE). With multiple locations in North America, this program is crafted to see you grow, develop and succeed. At Adobe, we want to create the next generation of sales professionals, and that starts with you!

title: Senior Data Engineer, Payments
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The community you will join
The AirCover Data Foundation team is responsible for providing trustworthy, consistent data and metrics to facilitate business insights, informed decision-making, and seamless operations across Airbnb's AirCover programs, such as Guest Travel Insurance, AirCover for Hosts, and AirCover for Guests. The team manages the end-to-end data lifecycle for guest and host protection programs, encompassing data ingestion and reconciliation with external insurance partners, as well as the construction of curated, offline analytics-ready data assets. This foundational data supports critical business functions, including claims and operations reporting, product experimentation, financial reconciliation, and the executive dashboards utilized by stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Data Science.
As AirCover continues its expansion into new markets and the introduction of new protection offerings, the data team plays a fundamental role in enabling trusted, data-driven decisions at every organizational level.
The difference you will make
As a Senior Data Engineer on AirCover Data Foundation, you will build and evolve the trusted data systems that power AirCover products and operations. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand business needs, secure the right data sources, design high-quality data models, and deliver robust data models and metrics. Your work will help Airbnb scale AirCover into new markets and new protection offerings with reliable data foundations for experimentation, operational excellence, reconciliation, and leadership reporting.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong software engineering fundamentals with data engineering judgment. You should be excited by building broadly useful data assets & metrics, improving trust in data quality, and translating complex business workflows and partner data into clean, consumable models.
What you’ll do
Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines that ingest, reconcile, transform, and publish data for AirCover products and operations.
Develop high-quality, analytics-ready data models and metrics that support executive reporting, claims and operations workflows, experimentation, financial reconciliation, and self-serve analysis.
Partner with software engineers and external-data stakeholders to translate source-system behavior and partner data feeds into trustworthy offline datasets.
Ensure data quality, consistency, accuracy, and documentation across critical AirCover data assets.
Improve the reliability, maintainability, and observability of pipelines through strong testing, monitoring, and engineering standards.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Analytics, and Data Science to define data requirements and deliver solutions that drive business outcomes.
Contribute to the broader Data Engineering community at Airbnb by influencing tooling, standards, and best practices.
Help raise the bar for foundational data systems that can scale with new AirCover markets, products, and regulatory or partner requirements.
What we’re looking for
6+ years of relevant industry experience in data engineering, software engineering, or closely related fields.
Strong experience designing and maintaining production-quality ETL or ELT pipelines.
Strong data modeling skills, including experience structuring data for business-relevant analytics and operational use cases.
Hands-on experience with large-scale distributed data processing technologies such as Spark and distributed storage systems.
Strong SQL skills and proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering, such as Python, Scala, or Java.
Experience with workflow orchestration or ETL scheduling frameworks such as Airflow.
Experience working with structured and third-party data sources, including reconciliation and transformation into trustworthy warehouse models.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Sound judgment around data quality, documentation, ownership, and long-term maintainability.
Nice to have
Experience supporting insurance, risk, trust, compliance, or financial data domains.
Experience working with external partner data feeds, reconciliations, or operational reporting systems.
Familiarity with experimentation data, executive metrics, or business performance dashboards.
Experience improving data quality frameworks, observability, or automated testing for critical data assets.

title: Principal Program Manager, WHS Strategy, Workplace Health and Safety
description:

WHS advances safety performance through three pillars: people, programs, and technology. The organization builds a self-sustaining safety culture, prevents incidents through engineering and standardized operational practices, and applies artificial intelligence and computer vision to drive faster, proactive safety interventions at scale.
We are seeking a Principal Program Manager to lead the WHS Strategy team. This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of enterprise strategy, executive communications, and operational safety performance. The leader in this position will serve as the primary owner of WHS's strategic planning cycle and will be accountable for the quality, coherence, and timeliness of the safety narrative presented to Amazon's most senior executives, including VP, SVP, and Board-level audiences.
This role requires a strategic leader who is effective under pressure, comfortable navigating organizational complexity, and capable of exercising sound judgment on matters with broad impact. The right candidate brings deep experience partnering directly with executive leadership, the ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems, and a consistent track record of delivering on high-stakes commitments. Key job responsibilities
This leader will own the end-to-end strategic planning lifecycle for WHS, including the development of 1 to 3 year strategic roadmaps, annual operating plans (OP1/OP2), and recurring executive reviews at monthly, quarterly, and annual cadences. Specific accountabilities include:
Collecting, synthesizing, and integrating strategic inputs from WHS teams across the organization, then drafting that content into a single, unified voice that reflects the WHS leader's perspective, ensuring consistent messaging, tone, and narrative alignment from document to document.
Authoring and managing the portfolio of WHS executive-level documents, ensuring analytical rigor, narrative precision, and strategic alignment across every deliverable that represents WHS to senior leadership.

Managing the enterprise planning calendar and orchestrating cross-functional inputs from a broad coalition of WHS field teams, central program teams, and operations stakeholders globally.
Translating complex operational programs, technical initiatives, and nuanced safety concepts into clear, concise, and accessible content for executive and non-specialist audiences.

You are a results-oriented leader with a genuine intellectual curiosity about what drives safety performance in complex operational environments. You combine strategic thinking with operational discipline: you can frame a multi-year vision and then build the mechanisms to bring it to life. title: Principal Tech Program Manager, AWS Hardware Engineering Services
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead cross-organizational hardware component initiatives within our Core Hardware Engineering organization. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the full lifecycle of mechanical and electrical components that power the entire AWS server fleet, from early architecture and design through manufacturing readiness, production ramp, and long-term fleet sustainment.
About the Role
Core Hardware Engineering is a horizontal organization that provides foundational hardware engineering capabilities across multiple vertical product lines within AWS Infrastructure. The mechanical portfolio includes fans, heatsinks, liquid cooling systems, cold plates, quick disconnects, chassis, rack frames, cables, and connectors. The electrical portfolio includes motherboards, power boards, system boards, PCIe switches and retimers, CPUs, and memory. As a Principal Technical Program Manager, you will own the strategy and delivery of component-level outcomes that serve every server platform in the AWS fleet.
What You Will Do
You will define and deliver complex component initiatives with broad cross-organizational impact in areas where business and architectural strategy has not yet been established. Your work begins before vertical server programs are formally defined and extends through manufacturing and long-term fleet sustainment, an end-to-end lifecycle span unique to this role.
You will own a portfolio spanning multiple component domains, dozens of active qualifications, concurrent technology transitions, and fleet-wide operations. You will orchestrate deliverables across multiple hardware engineering teams, managing prioritization and trade-offs between design, new product introduction, manufacturing, and sustaining operations to ensure engineering capacity is allocated against the highest-impact work.
You will drive strategic supplier relationships to reduce component lead times, establishing joint development roadmaps, negotiating capacity commitments ahead of demand signals, and creating multi-source qualification paths. You will hold commitments across vertical product teams, data center operations, manufacturing test teams, and external vendors, establishing scalable mechanisms for roadmap inspection, manufacturing readiness reviews, and cross-team dependency tracking that operate independently of your direct involvement.
You will deliver four primary outcomes: entitlement performance, manufacturing readiness, annualized failure rate and unsellable performance, and supply continuity, translating directly into platform readiness, cost reduction, and stability at scale.
Basic qualifications: - 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing the full hardware product lifecycle from design through manufacturing ramp and sustaining operations.
- Experience driving cross-organizational programs spanning multiple engineering teams, manufacturing operations, and external suppliers.
- Experience with component-level hardware development including mechanical and electrical systems.
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Preferred qualifications: - 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Direct experience with server or data center hardware at scale, including familiarity with ODM and JDM engagement models.
- Experience driving supplier development strategies, including joint development roadmaps, capacity planning, and multi-source qualification.
- Demonstrated ability to operate with complete independence in ambiguous environments where business and architectural strategy has not yet been defined.
- Experience establishing organizational mechanisms such as roadmap reviews, manufacturing readiness reviews, and supplier business reviews that persist and scale beyond individual involvement.
- Track record of delivering measurable business outcomes tied to total cost of ownership, time-to-market, manufacturing yield, and fleet reliability.
- Experience with firmware and software integration as it relates to hardware component readiness and platform bring-up.
- Master's degree in Engineering or an MBA.

title: Senior Program Manager, SSD R2L Delivery, Central Operations Strategy
description:
The Central Operations Strategy organization is seeking a Sr. Program Manager to own weather and incident response strategy for our last-mile delivery network. Weather is one of the largest drivers of unplanned variability in our operations, and this role owns the mechanisms that determine how we respond to it: how much capacity we protect, how much volume we accept, and how quickly we recover when conditions differ from what was forecast.
This role sits at the intersection of operations strategy and data. The Sr. Program Manager will build and own the reporting and analysis that show how weather affects delivery performance, translate weather forecasts into clear capacity recommendations, and measure whether those recommendations improved outcomes. They will partner closely with our central response team, meteorologists, and business stakeholders to land the right balance between volume and delivery quality for every event, and to improve the quality of the inputs driving those decisions over time.
The role requires strong program ownership and comfort making decisions with imperfect information. The ideal candidate can dig into the data to find the answer, then turn it into a clear recommendation and a durable process that operations teams can run every day.
Key job responsibilities
- Own the framework that measures how weather affects delivery quality and capacity, and the recurring reporting built on it
- Build and maintain the models and analysis that turn weather forecasts into capacity and volume recommendations grounded in historical performance
- Measure forecast accuracy and recommendation effectiveness, and drive improvements from what you find
- Partner with our central response team to improve response playbooks, escalation paths, and recovery actions for planned and unplanned events
- Partner with meteorologists to improve forecasting, feeding operational outcomes back into how forecasts are built
- Own the volume-versus-quality trade-off recommendation, sizing the cost of both over-reacting and under-reacting
- Build the tools and processes that let this program scale across the network
- Influence investment priorities through data-driven business cases, and drive alignment across operations, planning, finance, and technology partners
- Communicate strategy, risks, and trade-offs to senior leadership
Demonstrated Competencies
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to work independently with large data sets; SQL and - Python preferred
- High judgment with incomplete information
- Track record of building programs or reporting capabilities from scratch
- Willingness to go deep in an unfamiliar, technically complex domain and become the expert others rely on
- Proven ability to build consensus and drive decisions across large, diverse stakeholder groups
- Ability to simplify complexity for senior audiences
- Confidence in ambiguous, fast-moving environments
A day in the life
You start by reviewing how the network performed against recent weather events, and where results missed, working backwards to whether the fix belongs in the forecast, the recommendation, or execution. You spend part of the day in the data, refining the analysis behind our capacity recommendations and quantifying trade-offs. You partner with the central response team to prepare for upcoming events and with meteorologists to review where forecasts diverged from outcomes. The rest of your time goes to building mechanisms rather than reacting: better reporting, less manual work, and the documents that take your recommendations to senior leadership.

About the team
Central Operations Strategy owns the centralization strategy for order recovery, capacity management, and incident response across our last-mile delivery businesses. We centralize work that cannot scale at the site level, build automation to remove manual operational burden, and support the network through everything from new site launches to major disruptions. On the weather side, we measure how weather affects delivery performance, translate forecasts into capacity recommendations, and partner with meteorologists to improve forecast accuracy over time. We are a small team with broad ownership and the freedom to build what the network needs.

- Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate program work — for example, building analysis and reporting prototypes, automating recurring manual tasks, or synthesizing large volumes of operational data into insights and written recommendations.

title: ASE Observability SRE - Seattle
description:
People at Apple don't just build products — they craft the kind of experiences that have revolutionised entire industries. The diverse collection of our people and their ideas inspire innovation in everything we do. Imagine what you could do here! Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. The Apple Service Engineering (ASE) team builds and provides systems and infrastructure that fuel Apple's services (such as iCloud, iTunes, Siri, and Maps). We are the foundation on which Apple's software developers build the products that our customers love. We are looking for passionate and talented Site Reliability Engineers to continue our focus on providing our customers the highest quality Apple Services experience. Our services have to scale globally, stay highly available, and "just work." If you love designing, engineering, and running systems and infrastructure that help millions of customers, this is the place for you!
The Observability SRE organisation is specifically tasked with enabling other teams to better understand their infrastructure and services, providing world-class observability capabilities. Keeping Apple services up and running 100% of the time is a challenging job. Accurately monitoring the health of every application and infrastructure that comprises the Apple ecosystem 100% of the time is an order of magnitude more challenging. As a Site Reliability Engineer on the Observability Team, you will champion the availability, performance, and scaling of customer-facing production services, ensuring customers worldwide experience seamless, lightning-fast, and uninterrupted service. Our monitoring, alerting, and visualisation platform analyses billions of metrics per minute and comprises the central nervous system of Apple's architecture. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering teams to design and build the next generation of cloud and systems monitoring infrastructure, focusing on automation, availability, performance, and efficiency at "reach every user on the planet" scale.
Apple Services Engineering infrastructure is BIG. Operating at our scale, across multiple geographically dispersed data centers (including AliCloud regions serving China-mainland and global markets) and servicing hundreds of millions of users presents unique challenges. As an SRE at Apple, you'll solve these problems using data, teamwork, and your own expertise. SREs at Apple own the full infrastructure stack — from device driver performance debugging to content delivery network traffic management — our responsibilities are both broad and deep. title: Apple Developer App Engineer, WWDR
description:
Apps are changing the world and enriching people's lives, driven by developers dedicated to creating extraordinary experiences that delight customers. We are seeking a motivated and proven iOS and/or macOS app developer with an active interest in the Apple Developer community and a passion for improving the developer experience.
This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of the Apple Developer app and its underlying systems, helping bring technical and design content to our developer community during WWDC and throughout the year across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
We are looking for candidates with a passion for Apple technologies, strong communication and people skills, an eye for good design, and proven expertise building robust, native experiences with Swift and modern Apple frameworks.

Experience with automated testing frameworks (Swift Testing) and modern continuous integration and deployment pipelines
B.Sc. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Software Development, or Software Design Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

The passion for innovation that goes into our products applies to our practices as well, strengthening our dedication to leave the world better than we found it
Come and join the Global Subscriber Acquisition team who are responsible for driving growth and subscriber conversion for Apple TV. We are seeking a strategic Growth Lead, Acquisition Journeys for Apple TV, with a strong focus on funnel optimization, to help drive the next phase of subscription growth. title: Associate Platform Specialist, Apple Ads
description:
At Apple, we believe in the power of technology to enrich people's lives! Everything we build is designed—first and foremost—with helping people in mind. As an integral member of the Apple Ads Sales team, the Associate Platform Specialist role is pivotal in driving client success on Apple’s advertising platforms. title: CNC Machinist-Mill Turn
description:
The Product Realization Lab (PRL) is looking for a seasoned CNC prototype machinist to join our team. We're all about turning digital designs into real-world objects that can change the world. With decades of hands-on experience and hundreds of thousands of prototypes under our belt, we've honed a wide range of skills that cover almost every aspect of our work. title: Clean Energy Expert, Global Energy and Sustainability
description:
In Places, we don’t sit back and let things happen; we make things happen, and we do this in service to all Apple employees and customers. water, and waste management initiatives to leave the world better than we found it. 7+ years of experience working in clean energy project development, policy, standards or energy consulting in North America with international experience a plus.

Ability to leverage experience developing renewable energy as a developer or buyer when influencing standards, policy or regulatory proceedings.
Quantitative background with demonstrated ability to review carbon emissions models, and carbon accounting frameworks and provide technical feedback.
Attention to detail to read, summarize and influence standards, policy and regulatory filings.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills with ability to collaborate seamlessly with colleagues across departments and stakeholders throughout the industry.
Creative, out-of-the-box thinking, grounded in real-life experience and pragmatic problem solving as well as a curiosity and willingness to learn - leveraging energy expertise across an array of new topics.
Strong project management and time management skills to execute on multiple priorities in a fast-paced global setting.
Curiosity to learn and willingness to leverage energy expertise across an array of new topics.
Experience in Europe or Asia Pacific or experience participating in energy industry coalitions and facilitating stakeholder groups.

title: Computer Vision and Inertial Sensing Engineer
description:

Strong software engineering skills and programming in C++.
Familiarity with classical and machine learning based computer vision.

Excellent background in visual / inertial sensing and localization / mapping (SLAM).

title: Computer Vision/Deep Learning Engineer
description:

Creativity and curiosity for solving highly complex problems.

MS or PhD in related field.

title: Coordination SRE
description:
Apple’s Services Engineering organization (ASE) is seeking experienced distributed systems engineers to join our Coordination SRE team. You will be joining a team of experts, working at the cutting edge of modern distributed system deployment architectures. The team’s work is deployed at massive scale in data-centers worldwide, forming a platform upon which iCloud and many other internet services at Apple are built. In ASE, your work will benefit hundreds of millions of users and is critical to the success of Apple cloud infrastructure technologies.
The ASE Coordination SRE team develops applications and tooling that are safe, reliable, scalable, and fast. This work requires an innovative spirit and an extraordinary degree of care and rigor in engineering. Understanding of core SRE concepts - Monitoring, Alerting, Incident management. Proficient in one or more of the following programming languages: Java, Go (golang), Python

title: Data Scientist, Apple Pay
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist with the intellectual curiosity and strategic depth to reimagine how Apple Pay measures and optimizes its marketing. You don't wait to be handed a question; you identify the questions worth asking, conceptualize the right framework to answer them, and propose approaches that others haven't considered yet. You know the marketing and media landscape deeply: how marketing mix models quantify cross-channel marketing effectiveness using statistical or econometric models, how incrementally testing from geo-based experiments to causal inference methods — isolates true causal lift, and how behavioral signals derived from clustering, propensity modeling, or sequence analysis can shape smarter audience strategies and campaign design. AI/ML is the tool you bring to take those frameworks to a level of rigor, scale, and speed that wouldn't otherwise be possible whether that means building production-grade causal inference pipelines, designing ML-powered experiment analysis, or applying LLMs to accelerate how insights are generated and communicated.

• Strong proficiency in Python and data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, or equivalent)

• Familiarity with Generative AI and large language models, and comfort integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytical workflows

Preferred qualifications: • Experience with paid media data across channels, paid digital, in-store media, social, and other performance marketing platforms
• Experience with awareness and performance marketing measurement
• Actively follows industry trends in marketing science and media measurement — aware of emerging methodologies and tools and brings those perspectives into the team
• Experience applying Generative AI to marketing workflows, including budget optimization, automated creative analysis, or campaign performance reporting

title: Design Verification Engineer
description:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet and changing the game? We have an opportunity for an outstandingly hardworking design verification engineer! As a member of our wide-ranging group, you will have the rare and extraordinary opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers daily.
This role is for a DV engineer who will enable us to produce fully functional first silicon for IP designs. The responsibilities include all phases of pre-silicon verification including but not limited to: establishing DV methodology, test-plan development, verification environment development including stimulus and checkers, test-writing, debug, coverage, sign-off for RTL freeze and tape-out.
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring bug-free first silicon for part of the SoC / IP and are encouraged to develop detailed test and coverage plans based on the micro-architecture. You are responsible for developing verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring a scalable and portable environment. You will get to develop verification environment, including all the respective components such as stimulus, checkers, assertions, trackers, coverage. A mindset to break the design is highly desirable.
Furthermore, you will develop verification plans for all features under your care, execute verification plans, including design bring-up, DV environment bring- up, regression enabling features, and debug of the test failures. You will also learn to develop block, IP and SoC level test-benches track and report DV progress using a variety of metrics, including bugs and coverage. You will also be expected to make use of LLM and related technologies to achieve efficient execution and improved quality.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree in technical subject area with minimum 10 years of proven experience or equivalent.
Preferred qualifications: Deep knowledge of OOP, SystemVerilog and UVM
Deep knowledge in developing scalable and portable test-benches
Strong experience with verification methodologies and tools such as simulators, waveform viewers, Build and run automation, coverage collection, gate level simulations
Working experience using LLMs for efficiency and quality
Experience with power-aware (UPF) or similar verification methodology
Excellent knowledge of one of the scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL
Experience with serial protocols such as PCIe or USB, parallel protocol such as DDR is a plus but not required
Knowledge of formal verification methodology is a plus but not required
Knowledge of emulation for verification technologies is a plus but not required

title: Director, Product Management - Platforms (Apple Store Online)

title: Test & Instrumentation Development Engineer
description:
The Instrumentation and Test technology team architects and designs best-in-class, end-to-end test and measurements systems.
We are a collaborative group of creative and thoughtful people developing highly complex and sophisticated systems to validate the performance of sensors and other critical technologies in our world-class products.
This individual will play a key role in designing comprehensive test strategies, methodologies, and integrating the measurement systems to support new product introduction, characterization, ramp, and mass production. This includes everything from defining high level test plans to architecting the specific instruments required to execute them.
You will play a key role in architecting, designing, and deploying the complete test solutions—including hardware, software, and algorithms—for our next-generation products. Partnering closely with a wide range of cross-functional teams, you will develop the critical test methodologies and instrumentation needed for system characterization, calibration, and validation in a fast-paced and collaborative product development environment.
Minimum qualifications: Our ideal candidate has experience in test integration, implementation, and has a strong foundation in at least one of the following core areas: system or application-level test software or instrumentation hardware design.
Minimum of bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) with 10 years of relevant industry experience in a hands-on technical role.
3+ years of experience in a programming language like C/C++ or Python
Preferred qualifications: End-to-end Test Design: Experience creating and documenting comprehensive test plans, defining test cases and coverage, and developing validation methodologies for complex systems.
International Travel: This role requires international travel (up to 25%) to support our manufacturing partners during key product builds. This typically involves 2-4 trips per year at sites in Asia. Our team is committed to providing as much advance notice as possible to support your planning.
Curiosity and Adaptability: You are driven by curiosity, energized by solving novel problems, and motivated to learn new skills to get the job done.
Focused Problem Solving: You excel at identifying the most critical variables in a complex system and can develop a clear, focused plan of action even when all the details are not yet available.
Hands-on experience with electronics debugging tools.
Electrical engineering fundamentals (ability to read schematics & layout & component datasheets).
You have experience developing robust software and algorithms in a modern object-oriented or scripting language (e.g., Python, C++). Familiarity with the Apple ecosystem is a plus but not required.
Background in testing high-volume consumer electronics, particularly with Touch, Sensing, Display, or other complex user-facing technologies.
Knowledge of digital signal processing (DSP) or image processing algorithms.
Experience with instrument camera and optical capture system is a plus.
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate with cross-functional engineering and design teams.
Passion for learning and contributing across disciplines.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Excellent skills in debugging and performing failure analysis across software, hardware and system domains. Experience with structured problem-solving methodologies like Design of Experiments (DOE). Ability to perform and interpret statistical data analysis.
Master's degree preferred.

description:

Experience in RF schematic and PCB layout practices and guidelines.
Hands-on experience with RF lab instrumentation.
Ability to debug desense issues and characterize noise sources.
Experience with production environment and statistical analysis.
Excellent interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate effectively across cultures and geographical locations.
Strong collaborator, with ability to build strong relationships both within and outside the team.

About the Role
Join our Financial Services Consulting practice and help organizations strengthen governance, manage risk, enhance internal controls, and navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment.
As an Internal Audit Manager , you’ll work with banking and financial services clients on meaningful, high-impact engagements spanning internal audit, risk management, internal controls, and compliance. You’ll have the opportunity to lead client engagements, develop and mentor team members, build trusted relationships with client leaders, and recommend practical solutions that improve how organizations manage risk.
This role is ideal for an experienced internal audit professional who enjoys solving complex problems, leading teams, and working directly with clients in an entrepreneurial and collaborative consulting environment.

Lead and deliver internal audit, risk management, and internal control engagements for banking and financial services clients.
Plan engagements and manage project teams, including reviewing workpapers and providing coaching, feedback, and guidance to team members.
Conduct and oversee fieldwork, evaluate processes and controls, and develop well-supported conclusions and recommendations.
Communicate findings and observations to client management and prepare clear, actionable reports and presentations.
Advise clients on opportunities to strengthen and optimize internal controls and risk management practices.
Help clients enhance and transform internal audit approaches, methodologies, and operating models.
Perform risk assessments and identify opportunities to improve governance, processes, controls, and compliance.
Manage multiple projects and workstreams while maintaining strong client service and quality standards.
Manage engagement scope, staffing, workplans, budgets, schedules, billing, and overall engagement economics to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget.
Build trusted client relationships and contribute ideas that create additional value for clients and the firm.
Develop and expand relationships with client executives, identify emerging needs, and lead or contribute to proposals, scoping, presentations, and other sales-pursuit activities.
Coach and develop professionals through timely feedback, performance guidance, and career-development support, while holding project teams accountable for their commitments.
Contribute to market and practice growth through thought leadership, professional associations, recruiting, knowledge sharing, and development of new or improved service offerings.

Bachelor’s degree.
Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification

Experience managing projects and multiple concurrent workstreams and responsibilities.
Experience supervising, coaching, and reviewing the work of other professionals.
Strong understanding of internal control design and operating effectiveness.
Experience evaluating business processes, process flows, and flowcharts.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with clients and internal teams through interviews, meetings, presentations, reports, process narratives, and other formats.
Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability and willingness to travel as needed based on client and engagement requirements.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, or a Business or Economics degree with an Accounting minor or concentration.
Consulting or professional services experience supporting banking and financial services organizations.
Knowledge of GAAP financial accounting and SEC reporting requirements.
Experience advising organizations on internal audit transformation, risk assessments, internal controls optimization, or related risk and governance initiatives.

Experience operating in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where initiative, sound judgment, and effective project leadership are essential.

1. Solution Design and Configuration:
Assist in the design and configuration of NetSuite ERP solutions to meet specific business requirements.
Customize NetSuite modules, including Financials, CRM, Inventory, and Order Management, to align with client needs.
Develop and implement custom scripts using SuiteScript to extend NetSuite functionality.

Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Assist in the development of functional specification designs, including the definition of functional requirements and business scenarios.

Develop and implement integrations between NetSuite and other systems using SuiteTalk (Web Services), RESTlets, and other integration tools.
Ensure seamless data flow and communication between integrated systems.

Conduct unit testing and integration testing to ensure the functionality and performance of developed solutions.
Identify and fix bugs and issues in the codebase.
Assist in the development and execution of test plans, test cases, and test scripts.

Monitor and optimize the performance of NetSuite solutions to ensure they operate efficiently and effectively.
Implement best practices for performance tuning and optimization.

Share knowledge and best practices with the development team and the broader organization.

Provide technical support to end-users and clients, addressing issues and resolving technical problems.
Troubleshoot and debug issues in the NetSuite system and custom code.
8. Client Engagement and Support:
Engage with clients to understand their technical needs and provide solutions that meet their requirements.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted technical advisor.
9. Training and User Adoption:
Assist in developing training materials and conducting training sessions to ensure clients can effectively use the implemented NetSuite solutions.
Provide ongoing support and assistance to clients to ensure successful user adoption.
10. Collaboration with Cross-Functional Teams:
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and other developers, to ensure successful project delivery.
Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning and status updates.
11. Continuous Improvement and Learning:
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in NetSuite and related technologies.
Continuously improve development skills and knowledge through training, certifications, and self-study.
12. Adherence to Development Standards:
Follow established development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices.
Ensure code quality and maintainability through code reviews and adherence to development processes.
13. Risk and Issue Management:
Identify potential technical risks and issues related to NetSuite implementations and assist in developing mitigation strategies.
Monitor and report on the status of technical risks and issues to ensure they are addressed promptly.
14. Business Process Understanding:
Develop a strong understanding of the client's business processes and how they align with NetSuite capabilities.
Recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

NetSuite Expertise: Basic understanding of the NetSuite ERP platform and its capabilities.
SuiteScript: Proficiency in SuiteScript for customizing and extending NetSuite functionality.
System Integration: Basic knowledge of integration tools and techniques, including SuiteTalk (Web Services) and RESTlets.
Programming Languages: Proficiency in JavaScript for SuiteScript development.
Data Management: Basic knowledge of data management and database concepts.
Testing Tools: Experience with testing tools and frameworks for unit testing and integration testing.
Documentation Tools: Experience with documentation and knowledge management tools, such as Confluence or SharePoint
Expectations:
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Team Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously improve skills.
Willingness to travel 60% or more annually

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in: Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Operations Management, Healthcare Administration, Public Finance, Public & Environmental Affairs, Supply Chain, Public Policy, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Systems Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or comparable major.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Engineer, Chassis & Vehicle Dynamic
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike.  We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact.  We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries.  As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries.  We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better
About the Role
We’re looking for a Mechanical Engineer to develop and improve chassis systems and vehicle dynamics performance for DOT, DoorDash’s autonomous delivery robot. You’ll combine hands-on mechanical design, engineering analysis, and vehicle testing to improve existing platforms and develop suspension and chassis solutions for future projects.
You’ll own engineering work from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype evaluation, and validation. Working closely with internal teams and suppliers, you’ll assess designs, resolve technical challenges, and ensure chassis systems meet our performance, durability, and integration requirements.
This role offers the opportunity to influence how DOT rides, handles, brakes, and traverses real-world terrain while improving the reliability and serviceability of our deployed robots.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Design and improve suspension and chassis systems , including suspension geometry, linkages, wheel-end assemblies, and drivetrain and brake mounting interfaces.
Own mechanical design execution , developing concepts, detailed CAD models, engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerance analyses to support prototype builds and production release.
Sustain and improve existing platforms , investigating field issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing validated engineering changes.
Define chassis and vehicle dynamics requirements for ride quality, traction, braking, stability, ground clearance, and obstacle traversal across terrain and payload conditions.
Provide technical oversight of supplier-developed hardware , reviewing designs, analyses, and test results to ensure systems meet vehicle requirements and integrate successfully.
Develop and execute verification and validation plans with reliability, test, and integration teams, establishing measurable acceptance criteria for components and complete vehicles.
Lead instrumented vehicle dynamics testing , analyze results, and translate findings into hardware improvements and operating limits.
Partner with controls and autonomy engineers to characterize vehicle capabilities and improve motion performance.
Support prototype builds, manufacturing, and service teams , resolving integration issues and improving durability, manufacturability, and maintainability .
We’re excited about you because…
You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
You have experience designing and developing suspension, chassis, or related mechanical systems for vehicles or mobile robots.
You understand suspension kinematics, load transfer, tire behavior, stiffness and damping, braking, and vehicle stability—and can apply these fundamentals to hardware design.
You are proficient in NX, SolidWorks, CATIA, or a comparable CAD platform and have experience releasing detailed mechanical designs.
You apply sound engineering judgment to load cases, structural integrity, fatigue, bearings, bolted joints, materials, and manufacturing processes.
You can independently assess designs and analyses, identify technical risks, and drive issues to resolution with internal teams and suppliers.
You have hands-on experience with prototype assembly, instrumentation, vehicle testing, and root cause analysis.
You can translate requirements into test methods and acceptance criteria, then use Python, MATLAB, or similar tools to evaluate results.
You take ownership from initial investigation through implementation and verification

Fortune Brands runs on Boomi. The platform carries 445 integrations and roughly 1.75 million transactions a day, spanning 11 brands and 35 business capabilities, and nearly every customer-facing system we operate connects through it. It runs around the clock.
As Senior Boomi Integration Developer, you are the United States-based technical lead for that estate. You own integration architecture, you design, build, test, deploy and support the integrations themselves, and you make the call when something breaks in production.
You are also the bridge between two groups who need each other. Business teams describe what they need in their own language. Offshore developers build against your designs. Translating the first into the second, and holding the quality of what comes back, is a large part of this job and a large part of why it matters.

· Bachelor’s degree in information technology (IT), Computer Science (CS), Software Engineering, or related discipline.

· 3+ years of experience in API management.
· 2+ years of experience in ETL development.
· 1+ years of experience in EDI development.
· Strong experience with databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, NoSQL databases, or similar technologies.
· Proficiency with API and web service formats/protocols, including JSON, XML, SOAP, REST, and OData.
· Hands-on experience with integration, API, and EDI platforms, particularly Dell Boomi.
· Proficiency in programming and scripting languages such as SQL, JavaScript, and Groovy.
· Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for integration deployments.

description:

Primary Function of Position
The Senior Clinical Data Scientist will be part of the Ion business unit.  The Ion endoluminal system is Intuitive's robotic platform for minimally invasive biopsy in the peripheral lung, with an initial goal of improving the early diagnosis of lung cancer. The Senior Clinical Data Scientist sits at the intersection of clinical science and data science within the Ion business unit, translating clinical questions into rigorous, data-driven analyses that inform product strategy, evidence generation, and business decisions. This role reports to the Managing Staff, Clinical Data Science.
The individual in this role will partner with clinicians, cross-functional teams, and data engineering to design and execute a clinical data science strategy — defining hypotheses grounded in customer needs, identifying appropriate data sources, conducting quantitative analyses, and communicating results that demonstrably impact patient outcomes and business objectives. Unlike a purely clinical or purely technical role, this position demands both deep clinical understanding of the Ion platform and hands-on proficiency in modern data science methods and tools.
Success requires a strong technical foundation in Python or R, statistics, and causal reasoning; the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-evolving clinical and commercial landscape; and exceptional skill in communicating complex findings clearly — especially through polished visual presentations and well-organized documentation.
Essential Job Duties
Work with internal and external stakeholders (including clinicians, administrators, and policymakers) to identify data-centric needs in the clinical space and translate them into prioritized research questions with testable hypotheses.
Design, implement, and validate quantitative analyses in Python or R — applying appropriate statistical, machine learning, and causal inference methods to Ion device logs, clinical studies/registries, insurance claims databases, and EHR/EMR data — to test hypotheses.

title: Staff Mechanical Engineer - Future Opportunity
description:
At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.
As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare's hardest challenges and advance what is possible.
Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. We strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.
Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture. Our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.
Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let's advance the world of minimally invasive care.
The Staff Mechanical Design Engineer independently owns technically demanding mechanical and electromechanical subsystems for robotic systems. You will lead subsystem architecture and detailed-design decisions, resolve complex multidisciplinary problems, and contribute to integration decisions beyond your assigned subsystem.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining mechanical design ownership with technical guidance and mentorship. The role reports to a Manager of Mechanical Design Engineering in New Product Development.
Essential Job Duties
Own subsystem development from concept through verification and design transfer, including mechanical requirements, specifications, design-risk analyses and verification documentation. Support validation activities with the responsible functions.
Lead subsystem architecture decisions. Compare alternatives and justify tradeoffs.
Design precision mechanisms, joints and actuation assemblies. Select and size components such as motors, bearings, transmissions, brakes and sensors based on operating loads, motion requirements and expected life.
Use first-principles calculations and simulation to establish load paths, component margins, structural stiffness, dynamic behavior and fatigue life. Check assumptions and correlate models with test results.
Create and release CAD models, manufacturing drawings and design documentation. Apply GD&T and tolerance analysis to functional interfaces, assembly requirements and inspection.
Build, test, debug and iterate prototypes. Develop test methods and fixtures, investigate failures, and verify corrective actions.
Work directly with suppliers, supplier engineering, sourcing and manufacturing to resolve technical issues, improve DFM/DFA and cost, and prepare designs for transfer.
Collaborate with systems, electrical, controls, clinical, human factors, manufacturing, supplier engineering/sourcing, quality and regulatory partners to resolve requirements and subsystem interfaces.
Lead technical reviews and guide other engineers’ design and analysis approaches. Plan technical work across functions, set priorities, resolve risks and mentor engineers through problem-solving.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience developing robotic or complex electromechanical products in a regulated industry, with demonstrated independent subsystem ownership from concept through design transfer.
Working knowledge of design controls, risk management, verification and validation.
Deep expertise in first-principles mechanics and precision mechanisms, with demonstrated ability to perform stiffness, dynamics and fatigue analysis.
Proficiency in GD&T, tolerancing, materials, DFM/DFA and manufacturing processes.
Experience designing rotary or linear joints, sizing components, and justifying decisions through analysis; integrating actuation and sensing; and collaborating effectively with controls and electrical engineers.
Hands-on prototyping experience, including assembly, testing, debugging, and rapid iterations.
Proficient with CAD, simulation, and PLM tools such as SolidWorks, ANSYS, and Windchill.
Demonstrated technical leadership through design reviews, cross-functional decision-making, stakeholder influence and engineer mentorship.
Experience with risk management activities including FMEA, risk mitigation, and reliability assessments.
Required Education and Training
Required: Typical minimum Bachelor’s degree plus 14 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree plus 10 years, or a PhD plus 6 years.
Preferred: Master’s or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
Working Conditions
On-site four days per week in Sunnyvale, CA.
May involve extended periods of computer-based design and analysis work.
Must be comfortable occasionally working in lab environments, including prototype assembly, mechanical testing, and safe use of standard mechanical tools and fixtures.
Must be able to occasionally lift and handle 25 pounds.
Travel: 10%, including occasional visits to supplier and manufacturing sites.
Preferred Skills and Experience
The following skills and experience are not required but represent attributes of an ideal candidate.
Experience developing Class II or Class III medical devices, particularly surgical robotics or medical device capital equipment.
Direct application of standards and documentation frameworks such as ISO 13485, FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), IEC 60601, ISO 14971, and DHF.
Experience supporting production launch, manufacturing scale-up or post-launch reliability investigations, and applying those lessons to new product designs.
